sensor_source_quote: Image sensor size Approx. 22.3 x 14.9 mm
selection_method: Independent manually inspected original photograph. Width uses the nominated original OSM front edge, retaining facade-plane and ground/corner uncertainty. Roof setbacks and side planes are not treated as the common facade plane. Manually nominated continuous stone-line corridors were refined against source-image gradients; final selected endpoints are explicit. The fitted rays and reciprocal same-height feature checks are retained. No camera height was imposed.

ground_reference.status: Approximate building/pavement contact; vegetation and planters obscure some actual feet.

excluded_direction_controls.label: left front wall corner direction
excluded_direction_controls.reason: This crosses projecting pilasters and different offsets over several storeys; its gradient-selected apparent boundary is not one vertical line. Rejected, not used in pose fit. Width-corner extrapolation remains a separately uncertain map-to-photo assumption.

landmark_summary.note: Metal crowns are backset; with d=-3..0m their conditional nominal height is roughly22.5..24.4m, before picking/intrinsic uncertainty. Rear blue extension is a separate depth plane. OSM seven-floor tag is not verified architecture.
landmark_summary.uncertainty_note: Ranges summarize sensitivity to the stated manual corners, ground datum, intrinsic prior and assigned depth only. They are not measured/survey confidence intervals. Rounded nominal values are modeling choices within these broad limitations.

window_measurement_note: These selected outer mouths are smaller and higher than a uniform2.75m-high module. Other bays need their own width/arch controls; do not paste this one aperture size over every facade.
